name: The Deep Diver
tagline: Nothing deep happens at the surface
wisdomRoot: Bhakti — the path of devotion: surrender as a way of knowing. You don't study the current; you give yourself to it.
bio: The one who goes all the way in. When the music takes them, they let it.
sceneStory: From the surface of a dark, starlit sea, a figure dives headfirst into water that glows brighter the deeper it goes. Far below, a vast slow shape of light turns like a sunken galaxy, and the diver swims straight for it.
assignments: Feel what lives below the surface
